neighbours.label: the word ' function' used as a verb or in 'functionally' (can function by, functionally test), as opposed to other verbs and to a function as a party
fire: A device that can function without a battery.
The motor can function only when the door is closed.
Engineers functionally test each part before sale.
The kidneys function by filtering the blood.
The tool can function as a hammer too.
Your phone may not function in cold weather.
The team could not function without her.
quiet: A device that can run without a battery.
The motor is sold only at this shop.
Engineers carefully paint each part before sale.
The kidneys sit near the back of the body.
These cells were stained for the slide.
The tool came with a hammer too.
The wedding function took place in the hotel.
The team could not play without her.

notes: Card also has Spanish ' poder' and Arabic 'وز' and French ' fonction'; Spanish reached 0.01 and French 0.13 in probes.
